## {{< fa plus title="plus" >}} What should I continue working on? {#continue-working}

- [**Create or update your LinkedIn Profile:**]{.teal-text} Many employers look for this, so it’s generally a good idea to have a professional, complete, and up-to-date LinkedIn profile. Access our [LinkedIn 101 guidelines](https://brenconnect.bren.ucsb.edu/s/article/LinkedIn-101-How-to-Build-Your-Profile-Grow-Your-Network-and-Use-LinkedIn-for-Your-Job-Internship-Search){target="_blank} for our full guidance, including if you have reservations about creating a profile. If you would like us to take a look and review your LinkedIn profile, please feel free to indicate this in your Fall Career Appointment Questionnaire prior to your individual meeting.
